sloka: धर्मस्येहाभिकामार्थं मम चैवाचिचोदनात् ।प्रव्राजय सुतं रामम् त्रिः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥२-१४-९॥
transliteration: dharmasyehābhikāmārthaṁ mama caivācicodanāt ।pravrājaya sutaṁ rāmam triḥ khalu tvāṁ bravīmyaham ॥2-14-9॥

translations.english: You must uphold righteousness. I also urge you to do that. Send your son Rama to the forest. I am repeating this statememt thrice.
